bio: In 1940 Genevieve, 26, lived with her husband Nicholas at 1028 Bunker Hill Street; in 1935 she had been living in Taylor ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch gives her life as 1914 (Old Forge) – 2004 (Sun City West, Arizona), with a GenealogyBank obituary index entry ([R4-S2]).
